newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Strong earthquake rocks Philippine island of Luzon.
newsitem.headline: Strong earthquake rocks Philippine island of Luzon.

text.p: A strong earthquake was recorded north of Manila early on Thursday morning, the Royal Hong Kong Observatory said.

The quake, estimated to be 5.6 on the Richter scale, happened at 2 a.m. (1800 GMT). The epicentre was initially pinpointed on the main Philippine island of Luzon about 210 km (130 miles) north of the capital at 16.5 N 120.7 E, the observatory said.
